page.title: Minimalist app promo video in Swiss style, free
page.description: A Swiss-style promo video from your screenshots: a strict grid, one red accent, sharp type and precise cuts. Free, no signup, made in your browser.
page.blurb: White space, a visible grid and one red accent. Screens snap into their column, captions get a red highlight bar, and every cut is on time. It reads as confident and considered, which is what a developer tool should say about itself.
